A '''redbeast''' was a [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] scavenger and hunter that lived in the lower levels of [[Vandalar City]]. They lived in packs of two to twelve creatures. They were about one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] at the shoulder, with a length of two meters. They also had a one-and-a-half-meter bushy tail.

Redbeasts were remarkably hardy and adaptive. They were more resistant to [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] and extreme cold than [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Their jaws were extremely strong and filled with chisel-like [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] that could gnaw through most materials.
